ALGER, le 1er juillet 2026 (APS) — La mi: ALGIERS, July 1, 2026 (APS) — The Minister, High Commissioner for Digitization, Meriem Benmouloud, received the Director General of the e-Governance Academy (eGA) of Estonia, Hannes Astok. The meeting is part of the economic governance support program between Algeria and the European Union.
Le Haut-commissariat à la numérisation e: The High Commission for Digitization and eGA reviewed a concept note regarding the Algerian digital transformation acceleration project for the period 2026-2028. This project aligns with the national digital transformation strategy and the Digital Algeria 2030 vision.
Les discussions ont porté sur le dévelop: Discussions focused on the development of a modern public digital infrastructure, administrative interoperability, data governance, and the modernization of public services. Training programs and technical support were also discussed.
Le projet s'appuie sur un dispositif de: The project relies on a management mechanism complying with international standards, ensuring transparency and quality. The expertise of eGA in e-governance and interoperability was highlighted.
